title: Multiplier obstructions for Legendre pairs of length 333
authors: Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz
summary: A Legendre pair of length 333 would yield a Hadamard matrix of order 668, the smallest order presently unresolved by the Hadamard conjecture. We study the structured case in which both sequences are fixed by a common subgroup $H\leq(\mathbb Z/333\mathbb Z)^\times$ acting by coordinate multiplication. We prove that such a pair can exist only when $|H|\leq 6$. After a mod-3 compression reduces the problem to an order-108 kernel, there are exactly 30 subgroups. We exclude 21 of them, including all 19 subgroups of order at least 9. The final order-9 subgroup is eliminated analytically: its orbit…
